label: Microsoft Agent Framework
description: The workflow becomes a Microsoft Agent Framework flow: an async function for each block, Agent Framework Agents (an OpenAIChatCompletionClient, tools, a response_format for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's approval (the Agent Framework's approval_mode="always_require"). Runs need the Agent Framework installed on the server (`make framework FW=microsoft_agent_framework`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.wait: a Wait step needs saved checkpoints that a scheduler can wake days later: run this workflow on LangGraph (Framework in the workflow settings)
notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: the flow does not use the Agent Framework's WorkflowBuilder graph yet)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.llm: an Agent Framework Agent with the block's model, asked once with agent.run
notes.core.agent: an Agent Framework Agent (instructions, chat client, tools, a response_format in default_options); tools named in 'Ask before using' use @tool(approval_mode="always_require"): the run pauses, its AgentSession and the approval requests are saved, and the agent continues in that session once a person approves, edits or rejects each call (a rejected call's reason is the framework's own message)
notes.mw.model_call_limit: a chat middleware counts the agent's model calls in one turn: past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
notes.core.decide: the step asks its model once (an "Ask AI" call) to pick a path and say how sure it is, saves {choice, confidence, reason}, and the flow engine follows the choice (the default path when there is none or it is below the minimum confidence)
